freeze: One prospective analysis protocol of historically exposed game sets; no new original matches. Learn under a single, completely frozen map assignment. No candidate will be promoted based on these retrospectively available outcomes alone.
train: All 48 own archived games from opponent_policy protocol split=train (24 physical maps).
test1: All eight own archived split=val games (four different physical maps, both seats).
test2: All seven already-completed true original-vs-245b5814 games in dev1; identify eight registered tickets, one bilateral cold-failure has no moves.
steps: t=163,167,...,295, plus 296,297,298. Use every root on all three sets; eligibility decided before actions with observed cargo>=50, distance to a nearest own base at least 1, and (distance<=4 or remaining_moves-distance in [0,4]). No root, seat or nonvictory discarded from reporting. For every eligible unit, target is the other, original player's actually submitted physical worker order; our submitted same-turn orders are evaluation labels only.
model: One conditional linear logit residual to V1's opponent worker predictions on eligible original collectors. Public action-indexed features: change of shortest base distance, self action stays, reaching base, whether closest lower/equal-cargo rival can reach the target (distance <=1); interactions with log cargo, normalized return slack, deadline, and distance to base. No actual pending enemy action nor future game state in input. Fit physical-map-equal likelihood plus 0.5 KL(old||new) and ridge .05*||w||^2, max 50 L-BFGS iterations. Halve learned readout until mean training KL<=.025 and max absolute logit delta<=1.5. No experimental weight fitting on dev1 or val.
deployment_action_metric: Use actual reserved original _sample, correct 0.58 model's root CRN seed0+7, same native cash/shared occupancy. Primary actual eligible collector movement/arrival correct counts in each held set, both require positive improvement and nonnegative more-or-equal 3 of 4 physical maps. Then report actual deposit intents (adjacent carrier eligible, true official submitted actions), lighter-rival within two opportunities and projected joint collisions using actual opponent response, false alarms and misses, prospective causality limits. Soft NLL secondary. No followup tuning. No promotion without real independent duel.
